note: Black Hills NF campground in Little Spearfish Canyon, about 3.5 miles west of Savoy on gravel FSR 222 (Roughlock Falls Road), near Little Spearfish Creek under pine canopy. The Little Spearfish Trail loop starts beside it. --Claude
